id: W:burke|reflexoes sobre a revolucao em franca
original_title: Reflections on the Revolution in France
note: Portuguese translation of the 1790 work; the cited 1982 date is an edition date.

original_title: Gramsci et le bloc historique
note: Portuguese translation of Portelli’s French monograph, not Gramsci’s own writings.

id: W:tocqueville|o antigo regime e a revolucao
original_title: L’Ancien Régime et la Révolution
note: Same book as the French-language candidate L’Ancien Régime (1969, Headlam edition); prefer it to the English translations. Candidate w-2789 describes only the foreword.

original_title: Bible
note: Generic Portuguese Bible citation. Translator, canon and publisher are unspecified, so the particular 2014 edition and its identifier cannot be established. Catalogue example does not identify the cited edition; no identifier guessed.

original_title: L’invention démocratique : les limites de la domination totalitaire
note: Portuguese edition of Lefort’s collection, first published in French in 1981; 1987 is the second Brazilian edition.

original_title: Historia intelectual: la retórica como clave de lectura
container: Original: Prismas, 2(2), 1998, pp. 149–168. Cited revised Portuguese version: Topoi, 1(1), 2000, pp. 123–152.
note: Independent article absent from candidates. Topoi identifies its 1998 Prismas predecessor; DOI identifies the cited 2000 Portuguese revision, not the Spanish publication.

original_title: Memoria
container: Enciclopedia Einaudi, vol. 8: Labirinto–Memoria (Torino: Einaudi, 1979), pp. 1068–1109. Portuguese: Enciclopédia Einaudi, vol. 1: Memória–História (Lisboa: INCM, 1984), pp. 11–50.
note: Encyclopaedia entry, not the whole Storia e memoria / History and memory collection. ISBN is the original encyclopaedia set identifier, not a separate chapter ISBN.

id: W:velho|frentes de expansao e estrutura agraria
original_title: Frentes de expansão e estrutura agrária: estudo do processo de penetração numa área da Transamazônica
note: By Otávio Guilherme Velho; cited author string is truncated. No candidates. Original Zahar edition; WorldCat’s Spanish language label is erroneous, as confirmed by the Museu Nacional dos Povos Indígenas catalogue.

original_title: Seuils
note: Portuguese translation of Seuils; prefer the French original to Paratexts (1997).

original_title: Проблемы поэтики Достоевского
note: Translation of the expanded 1963 version. The earlier 1929 version was titled Problemy tvorchestva Dostoevskogo; candidate w-256619 has a suspect 1921 date.

original_title: Flesh and Stone: The Body and the City in Western Civilization
note: Same book; first published in 1994. Candidate’s 1997 date identifies a later edition.

original_title: Histoire et sciences sociales : La longue durée
container: Original: Annales. Économies, Sociétés, Civilisations, 13(4), 1958, pp. 725–753. Cited translation: Revista de História, 30(62), 1965, pp. 261–294.
note: The 1965 citation is a Portuguese translation of the 1958 article, not the 1972 essay collection. DOI identifies this Portuguese publication.

original_title: The Image of the City
note: Portuguese translation of the 1960 book; candidate dated 1969 is a later English edition.

original_title: Système de la mode
note: Portuguese translation of Système de la mode; prefer French original over The fashion system.

original_title: L’histoire orale : bilan d’un quart de siècle de réflexion méthodologique et de travaux
container: Original report: XVIIIe Congrès international des sciences historiques, Montréal, 1995, pp. 205–228. Portuguese chapter: Usos & abusos da história oral, ed. Marieta de Moraes Ferreira and Janaína Amado (Rio de Janeiro: FGV, first ed. 1996), pp. 43–62.
note: Chapter absent from candidates; not Ces voix qui nous viennent du passé. ISBN is for the Portuguese containing volume. French antecedent documented in Ferreira’s bibliography at https://repositorio.fgv.br/bitstreams/d60fc77b-05b8-4a99-b073-a1ae3cb4c6f3/download .

id: W:torres|historia das ideias religiosas no brasil
original_title: História das idéias religiosas no Brasil (a Igreja e a sociedade brasileira)
note: Exact 1968 title by João Camilo de Oliveira Torres. Cited author expansion incorrectly names João Carlos Feo Cardoso de Castello Branco e Torres; title and year make the intended author certain.

original_title: Spie : radici di un paradigma indiziario
container: In Aldo Gargani (ed.), Crisi della ragione (Torino: Einaudi, 1979), pp. 57–106; revised in Miti, emblemi, spie (1986). Portuguese: Mitos, emblemas, sinais (1989), pp. 143–179.
note: Individual essay, not candidate w-955 or w-238836, which are containing collections. ISBN identifies Crisi della ragione. An earlier form appeared in 1978 under the subtitle Radici di un paradigma scientifico.

original_title: Legenda aurea
note: Jacopo de Varazze is Jacobus de Voragine. Medieval compilation, composed circa 1260 and subsequently revised; year approximate. ISBN confirms Hilário Franco Júnior’s 2003 Portuguese edition. No candidates supplied.

original_title: The Power of Ideology
note: Mészáros’s book, translated into Portuguese in the cited 1996 edition; no candidates supplied. ISBN is for the 1989 English original.

original_title: Opera aperta : forma e indeterminazione nelle poetiche contemporanee
note: Portuguese translation of Opera aperta. Prefer Italian-language candidate (1976 edition) over L’Œuvre ouverte and The open work; original publication was 1962.
